ev.q: The percentage of children and adolescents aged 0–17 years using telemedicine during the past 12 months declined from 18.3% in 2021 to 14.2% in 2023.
Telemedicine use declined across all three age groups during this period. In both 2022 and 2023, telemedicine use increased with age.
